intro: The faculty members of the department are currently active in various research areas, spanning power and energy systems, signal processing and communication, and microelectronics and VLSI design.

domains.title: Power Engineering
domains.summary: Renewable integration, power systems, high-voltage engineering and advanced dielectric materials.

domains.title: Signal Processing & Communication
domains.summary: Communication systems, signal and image processing, computer vision and deep learning.

domains.title: Microelectronics & VLSI Design
domains.summary: Semiconductor devices, nanoelectronics, photonics, high-speed interconnects and mixed-signal circuits.
areas: Low-power communication networks for multi-core architecture
Development and applications of novel materials for high-speed circuits
Analog, RF and Mixed Signal VLSI Circuits and Systems
High-speed interconnect design for on-chip and chip-chip applications
